english.title: Take a vehicle into a hanger without permission at Luton Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) took a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), into a hanger, namely **(..SPECIFY THE HANGER..), used for the maintenance or storage of aircraft at Luton Airport without the permission of the authorised occupier or his authorised servants, employees or agents
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 2.7 and 7.2 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
